Synopsis:
    Major commodity traders Olam and Louis Dreyfus are preparing large arabica coffee deliveries to ICE exchange warehouses, targeting certification ahead of the December futures contract. ICE certified stocks have fallen to 26-year lows (~220,000 bags), a key driver of elevated prices near $3/lb. Expected deliveries of ~300,000 bags could more than double current stocks, likely putting downward pressure on arabica prices. Algorithm-driven funds are primed to sell on rising exchange stocks, amplifying the potential bearish price impact.
